# Budget

> A local-first budget app served as a static SPA at
> budget.niclaslindstedt.se. The user's ledger lives in their browser's
> localStorage and, optionally, in their own Dropbox app folder. There
> is no backend, no account on a server, and no analytics SDK.

## Pages

- [Home](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/): the app itself. SPA;
  requires JavaScript.
- [Privacy policy](https://budget.niclaslindstedt.se/privacy/): how
  Budget handles your data. Local-first, no backend, no analytics.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/budget):
  source, issues, releases. MIT-licensed.
